title: 06. Typing & Models: DATACLASS ALTERNATIVES — attrs & NamedTuple
summary: DATACLASS ALTERNATIVES — attrs & NamedTuple: TYPING.NAMEDTUPLE vs COLLECTIONS.NAMEDTUPLE vs DATACLASS vs ATTRS; 1. collections.namedtuple (old style).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/dataclass_alternatives.py
# ============================================================
# TYPING.NAMEDTUPLE vs COLLECTIONS.NAMEDTUPLE vs DATACLASS vs ATTRS
# ============================================================

# --- 1. collections.namedtuple (old style) ---
from collections import namedtuple
PointOld = namedtuple("PointOld", ["x", "y"])
p = PointOld(1, 2)
# Immutable, indexable, lightweight

# --- 2. typing.NamedTuple (modern, with types) ---
from typing import NamedTuple

class Point(NamedTuple):
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float = 0.0

p = Point(1.0, 2.0)
print(p.x)     # 1.0
print(p[0])    # 1.0 (still indexable!)
# Immutable, hashable, type hints

# --- 3. dataclass ---
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class PointDC:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float = 0.0
# Mutable by default, not indexable, rich features

# --- 4. attrs (third-party, very popular) ---
# pip install attrs
import attr

@attr.s(auto_attribs=True, frozen=True, slots=True)
class PointAttrs:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float = 0.0
    
    @x.validator
    def _validate_x(self, attribute, value):
        if value < 0:
            raise ValueError("x must be non-negative")

# ============================================================
# COMPARISON TABLE
# ============================================================
# Feature          | namedtuple | NamedTuple | dataclass | attrs
# -----------------|------------|------------|-----------|------
# Mutable          | No         | No         | Yes*      | Yes*
# Type hints       | No         | Yes        | Yes       | Yes
# Indexable        | Yes        | Yes        | No        | No
# Validation       | No         | No         | Manual    | Built-in
# Slots            | Always     | Always     | 3.10+     | Yes
# Default factory  | No         | No         | Yes       | Yes
# Hashable         | Yes        | Yes        | If frozen | If frozen
# * = frozen option available
```
